reviews.text: So far, so good I have not had any promise with the people at the dog  grooming place and my dogs are always being taken care of pretty good.

Dont take ur dog here the old Hispanic lady treats dogs are mean and doesn’t know how to cut hair right , when I asked her to cut my dog hair some more she rolled her eyes and grabbed my dog aggressive. That is NOT inappropriate!
Takes great care of my dog , the people here are kind and my dog comes out happy highly recommended , rare to find people that really care

Linda is the most patient groomer we have experienced. Extremely professional and considerate, very gentle with the pets. She only uses the best products on the grooming. Our cat received five types of shampoo to get him looking sparkly!
Great!!!!!I really  recommend. The crew is very friendly patient and careful. We have a podlle toy  18 years old
My babies come out happy with their haircuts (Pomeranian &  standard poodle) and their beautiful styles.

I have used Linda's grooming for  years. This time is the worst cut grooming ever. No straight lines on my Yorkie's face uneven cut didn't brush face upon picking up my dog. My wife said job was unacceptable. I returned promptly but the shop closed early. I will go back in the morning.  I don't think the owner was on the premises.

Nice place, clean and friendly owner & staff.
I been bringing my 2 dogs for over 3 years and will continue going back to this place.
Linda's does a fantastic job! My fifteen year old mix looks fantastic and smells wonderful.  I would definitely recommend Linda's Grooming Salon!
Amazing!! My dog loves going to get groomed with Linda.

They truly are the best! I've moved to two other states and returned to Houston for work, and without a doubt, nowhere else can I make my dog ​​look so beautiful. 100% guaranteed. My deepest respect to these lovely people at Lindas Grooming for working magic on dogs. Thank you!
Always does it great job with our furry family!
Love the service they always fit my fur babies in and take very good care of them!!
Linda and her crew always take great care of our dogs. We get regular grooming as well as the occasional boarding.
Excellent service, very professional with their work and Luna looked beautiful :)
This place does really good work. Price for grooming is very reasonable. They do not require proof of vaccines which can be good or bad. My dog is vaccinated though.
